ops-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: SEV2 - streaming p99 latency > 5s across us-west1 (service=streaming-gateway)
ops-bot: auto-escalation -> #incidents paging maya (oncall), liam - sre
maya (oncall): ack, paging in. I'm on it. switching to incident channel voice.
liam - sre: seeing p95 jump from 120ms -> 1.2s and p99 ~5.3s starting 02:12 UTC. error spike maps to proxy write timeouts (502 / upstream timed out).
ev an - infra: tagging in — checking ALB and nginx proxy pools. cpu on proxy hosts at 80%, connection count +3x from baseline.
dario - runtime: adding runtime note — tail latency seems correlated with clients that keep long-lived SSE connections + sporadic slow consumers. KV cache pressure looks normal.
zara - support: we have one high-traffic customer (AcmeCorp) reporting streaming lag and partial outputs. they saw gaps in SSE payloads and reconnects.
liam - sre: quick diagnostic log head (filter):
```
2026-03-15T02:12:08Z ERROR proxy/write timeout writeBytes=16384 conn_id=xyz upstream=10.2.3.4:8080
2026-03-15T02:12:09Z WARN stream/sse chunk_delay=2.6s conn_id=xyz client_window=small
```

maya (oncall): thanks. first mitigations: 1) increase proxy_read_timeout to 90s on edge for active streaming route 2) temporarily disable proxy_buffering for sse endpoints 3) open burst capacity on dedicated pool. doing 1 & 2 now.
ev an - infra: patch to nginx applied to 3 / 5 edge nodes:
```
location /v1/stream {
  proxy_buffering off;
  proxy_read_timeout 90s;
  proxy_send_timeout 90s;
  proxy_buffer_size 64k;
}
```

liam - sre: also bumping keepalive from 5 -> 30s on upstreams to reduce churn. rolling change.
dario - runtime: toggled continuous-batching=false for streaming workers on the affected gate so we avoid large batching stalls (small clients + long-lived conns). will monitor.
zara - support: notifying AcmeCorp with interim note: "we're seeing intermittent chunking delays, engineers actively mitigating; next update in 15m."
ops-bot: Incident severity updated -> SEV2. start_time=2026-03-15T02:12:00Z
liam - sre: immediate datapoints after nginx patch: p95 down to 300ms, p99 ~1.8s (partial improvement). Connection timeouts reduced but some slow consumers still causing head-of-line issues.
maya (oncall): good. action item: collect list of long-lived SSE connections with client window size < 16k and match to customer ids. liam, can you run quick query?
liam - sre: running query: `select conn_id, client_window, bytes_queued, duration from streaming_connections where duration>120s and client_window<16384` -> ~420 connections in us-west1, top 3 customers: AcmeCorp(120), BetaGames(84), DataSyncCo(60).
dario - runtime: for those customers I'm enabling per-connection pacing: `max_pending_bytes=65536` and tightening socket write backpressure so proxy isn't blocked by a single slow consumer. applying to canary subset (10%).
ev an - infra: canary 10% applied to two edge nodes. metrics: write queue depth reduced by 40% on canary. pushing to remaining nodes now.
zara - support: AcmeCorp confirmed they see fewer reconnects, but still occasional 3-5s tail delays on big payloads.
liam - sre: root cause hypothesis: combo of slow-client backpressure + default proxy buffering + keepalive churn produced head-of-line stalls, amplified during sudden connection burst. proxy timeouts then triggered upstream retries increasing load.
maya (oncall): agreed. next steps: 1) keep current nginx + keepalive changes rolled 2) apply pacing globally 3) monitor p95/p99 for 30m 4) follow-up postmortem if p99 > 2s after 30m.
liam - sre: creating alert rule to notify if p99 > 2s for 5m. `alerting: streaming_p99_high_uswest` -> thresholds set.
dario - runtime: pushed global pacing; runtime flag `streaming.per_conn_max_pending=65536` now true across region.
ops-bot: 2 PagerDuty reminders suppressed (manual mitigation underway).
maya (oncall): monitoring dashboard: after all changes p95 ~180ms, p99 ~800ms. traffic normalized. no more upstream 502s. marking incident as mitigated, keeping channel open for 30m observation.
zara - support: sending final note to AcmeCorp with workaround tips (enable client keepalive, bump client receive buffer).
maya (oncall): handing off to overnight oncall (evan - infra) in 28m for watch. liam, dario — please add notes to the incident doc with config diffs.
liam - sre: will write runbook snippet and follow-up postmortem.
maya (oncall): thanks team. closing active mitigation. if p99 regresses reopen. :thumbsup:
